title: A Vector for the Protocol Revisited
author: Wendell Fairweather
blurb: August Voss, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
